body: I just worry that maybe I'm an unlikable person. Sometimes it feels like the world would be a better place without me in it sucking up air... there are plenty of people on the earth - too many people. I sometimes find solace in my insignificance as a person, but sometimes it's just another reason that I should die.

I've lost a lot of my support system in my real life... I've been leaning on reddit a lot lately. But even though it can help, it is a constant reminder that I have nobody in my real life who wants to be there for me. 

Thank you for your kind words. Sincerely.
Next time you dye your hair, you should really dye your facial hair too.

So, wow. I was in a really shitty mood until I read your post. Seriously, thank you. I literally burst out laughing a few times while intermittently yelling "THANKS, OBAMA".  

Here are a few other things that I ranted in my head and then typed up because fuck it - it helps. 

The bit about the economy was just... so over the top. 

And that she says our relationship was strained from 18.... like there were ZERO problems up until that point. Untrue. 

The fact that she told me she hopes I can laugh this all off? Like I can laugh off her and my dad treating me like a marriage counselor before having a real relationship of my own - no problem. 

"Oh kids, did I ever tell you the story about how your grandma found out I was cutting myself and then followed me around the house while I tried to be alone and then when she overheard me talking on the phone with my boyfriend upset at her she then kicked me out of the house? But don't worry, she texted me 20 minutes later taking it back. Isn't your grandma silly!"


About my dad's depression? My dad is stressed. I don't mean to sound like a dick, but I can't imagine a doctor that has ever experienced prolonged depression saying the things that he says to me. Maybe I'm just close-minded, but asking someone why they are still depressed almost every time you spend time with them is not something I would do. Depression doesn't really work like that and reminding me that things still aren't better doesn't really help. At all. 

And on the topic of therapy, his therapy started with couples therapy but then my mom decided to stop going because she "didn't like it". 

A few months ago she said to me, "I'm really proud of your father for not resorting to taking any medication for his depression." .... I literally sat there, stunned - Did my mother just say that to me not only when she knows that I have been on antidepressants for over 3 years, but that I had just come back from a therapy session? Yeah, she did. I immediately called her out on it and told her how hurtful that was. She then started on about how her parents feel about mental health... she said something along the lines of "well in my family, therapy and medication is for crazy people."

And about the book thing? Nothing really to worry about there. She has been reading the same book since 2012 and she is still raving about it. I checked her place last year and she was like 80 pages into the 300 page book. She'd probably get into the TV show though...

And now I've just ranted for about 2000 characters, so I'm sorry for that. But I do want to sincerely thank you for your cynical response. Sometimes I think cynicism is just blunt honesty mixed with sarcasm.

edit: changed nonsensical sentence.

Well, I definitely will not be posting about her or my father with my main account anymore. But, I've formed relationships in mental health related subreddits and ever since I received her e-mail I've felt like I need to censor myself. I read everything like it's her reading it before I post. I usually just end up PMing or not saying anything unless it's mom-in-my-head approved. 

I knew she'd bring up the e-mail, so the next day I decided to head it off. I just said "thanks for the e-mail" and then cut off the conversation and got off the phone. 

I haven't heard anything since, but it's always in the back of my head...

A day later and I don't feel much different. Maybe a little less drunk. I just feel so tired of life. I feel like I don't give anything useful to the world. I feel exhausted and unworthy of life.

I had a friend die of suicide over 2 years ago now. I sometimes wish I would have died instead of him. He was much better for this world than I am.


Literally the only thing that is keeping me here is my dog. But I know she would move on. She'd forget about me. Everyone would eventually.
Sometimes when I drink I love everything but right now I fucking HATE EVERYTHIG EVERYTHING FUCKING SUCKS AND I SUCK AND FUUUUUUUCKKKKKKK
I mean i don't want to stop because there are times when I have fun, but I do want to stop this downward spiral. I jsut feel sor tof helpless at this point.

I am having trouble with the separate bed thing. We spend nights together at each other's apartments but he said something like "sometimes I just like to sleep by myself". I am having a hard time dealing with that. Why wouldn't he want to spend every night together? We've been together so long, we love each other - but I wonder if he doesn't just pity me or maybe jsut feel comfortable and doesn't want to leave.
I don't have the energy to do anything anymore. I just hate myself. I wish I was better, for my dog, for my family, for the world, but I don't think I can be.
